CREATE TABLE "reconciliations" (
  "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "evidence" TEXT,
  "evidence_reference" TEXT,
  "id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "notes" TEXT,
  "payment_attempt_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "payment_intent_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "reason" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "resolution" TEXT,
  "resolved_at" TEXT,
  "resolved_by" TEXT,
  "started_at" TEXT,
  "started_by" TEXT,
  "status" TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  UNIQUE ("payment_attempt_id"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("payment_intent_id") REFERENCES "payment_intents" ("id"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("payment_attempt_id") REFERENCES "payment_attempts" ("id")
)

execute.sql: CREATE TRIGGER reconciliation_attempt_matches BEFORE INSERT ON reconciliations WHEN NEW.status <> 'REQUIRED' OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payment_attempts a JOIN payment_intents p ON p.id = a.payment_intent_id WHERE a.id = NEW.payment_attempt_id AND a.payment_intent_id = NEW.payment_intent_id AND a.status = 'UNKNOWN' AND p.status = 'UNKNOWN') BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'reconciliation_attempt_matches'); END

CREATE TRIGGER reconciliation_state_insert BEFORE INSERT ON reconciliations WHEN NEW.status NOT IN ('REQUIRED', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'RESOLVED') OR
  (NEW.status = 'RESOLVED' AND (NEW.resolution IS NULL OR NEW.resolution NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED') OR NEW.resolved_at IS NULL OR NEW.resolved_by IS NULL OR NEW.evidence_reference IS NULL OR NEW.evidence IS NULL OR NOT json_valid(NEW.evidence))) OR
  (NEW.status <> 'RESOLVED' AND (NEW.resolution IS NOT NULL OR NEW.resolved_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.resolved_by IS NOT NULL OR NEW.evidence_reference IS NOT NULL OR NEW.evidence IS NOT NULL)) OR
  (NEW.status = 'REQUIRED' AND (NEW.started_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.started_by IS NOT NULL)) OR
  (NEW.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND (NEW.started_at IS NULL OR NEW.started_by IS NULL)) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'reconciliation_state_insert'); END
